vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A dependency with a known advisory does not wait for the weekly window.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Every cargo call in CI passes --locked, so without this Cargo.lock only moves when someone runs cargo update by hand. The MSRV leg of the test matrix catches a refresh that raises the rust-version floor.

packageRules.description: Base-image digest bumps are unscheduled: the Dockerfile pins by digest and only a new digest takes a security fix.
